Daily Devotional

September 15

8 For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: 9 Not of works, lest any man should boast. 10 For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them. (Ephesians 2:8-10 KJV)

We are saved by grace (undeserved, unmerited favor) by God, and it has nothing what so ever to do with our own works, as it is just a gift from God. The faith that we use to be saved is also a gift from God, and is not our human faith. How do we obtain this God given faith? By hearing the Word of God (Romans 10:17). That is why a person must hear the Gospel before he can be saved, as faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the Word of God. They must also be drawn by the Holy Spirit, as Jesus said (John 6:44).

We are the workmanship of God, and are baptized into the body of Jesus Christ unto good works. Doing good works does not save us, but we are saved in order to do good works of faith, not works of the law. Our good works did not save us, but we should love God enough, after our salvation, to want to do good works of faith, not to earn from God, but to show our love for God, as faith without works is dead (James 2:20). We must do what Jesus has commanded us to do, to assure our eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9). Let your light shine out into this dark world – praise God.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
